item.title: TVD Radar: Savages, Adore Life 10th anniversary reissue in stores now
item.description: VIA PRESS RELEASE | On January 22, 2016, Savages released its riveting sophomore album Adore Life, the band’s final release to date. Today, the London quartet celebrate the album’s first decade by sharing two unreleased songs from the era—a piano-lead cover of Black Sabbath’s iconic “Paranoid” and the haunting original “Prayer.” Stream both tracks now.
